current_evidence: The council's 'What documents do I need to submit with my planning application?' page (hastings.gov.uk/planning/how/documents/) links only to this PDF, and the PDF itself is headed Version 26, September 2026; no newer list was found by search.

issues.detail: Many local requirements in Section 2 are not in Grokbot's app_type_rows at all: Economic Statement (new employment uses or loss of B-class/E(g) uses); Noise Assessment (industrial uses next to housing, restaurants/cafes with noisy extraction, air conditioning/condenser units); Parking Plans (loss or gain of parking, more parking demand, access changes; include cycle storage); Planning Statement (all major); Retail or Leisure Impact Assessment (retail or leisure over 2,500 sq m on an unallocated site); Road Safety Audit Stage 1 (major schemes with highway works or new access; some non-major); Sequential Test for main town centre uses outside centres; Site/Topographical Survey (new dwellings and all major); Statement of Community Involvement (departures, over 1,000 sq m non-residential, over 10 dwellings); Sustainability Statement (all major); Telecommunications Statement and ICNIRP compliance (mobile base stations); Transport Assessment/Statement and Travel Plan (ESCC 2020 thresholds); Tree Survey/AIA/Method Statement to BS5837 (trees on or next to the site, or TPO trees); Ventilation/Extraction details (cafes, restaurants, takeaways, any on-site cooking).
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist v26, Section 2 'Local Requirements', 'Applications that require this information' column for each row

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but several local requirements explicitly or by their trigger cover householder extensions: Biodiversity/Ecology Information ('This applies to changes of use, new build and extension applications'); Heritage Statement and HER checklist (any application affecting a heritage asset or its setting); Tree Survey (trees on or next to the site); Parking Plans; Flood Risk Assessment ('all development, including minor development'); Land Stability Declaration Form (Article 4 Cliff Stability Area, including upward extensions).
issues.evidence: Biodiversity/Ecology Information: 'All sites have the potential to support protected species... This applies to changes of use, new build and extension applications.'

issues.detail: Grokbot puts nearly every local requirement under Full planning, each with an 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning' note (e.g. Affordable Housing Statement, Air Quality, BNG, Heritage Statement, Viability, Roof plan). It then marks Outline, Reserved matters and S73 as '(none)'. The source does not split by application type. Its triggers are about development scale or site conditions (e.g. 'All Major Developments', 'one or more net additional dwellings'), so these apply equally to outline and other application types.
issues.evidence: Section 2 triggers are expressed as 'All Major Developments', 'Any residential development... creating one or more net additional dwellings', etc., not by application type

issues.detail: Section 3 (Prior Approval - upward extensions) is not captured at all. It lists the information needed for Part 1 Class AA (extra storeys on a dwellinghouse) and Part 20 Classes A, AA, AB, AC and AD (new dwellings on detached blocks of flats, commercial/mixed-use buildings and houses): a written description, a scaled plan with north point, existing and proposed elevations, floor plans, the addresses of flats, the developer's contact details, and a site-specific FRA where the EA must be consulted. Grokbot's only prior approval row is a Fire Statement.
issues.evidence: Section 3 headings 'Class AA, Part 1, Sch. 2 GPDO' and 'Class A/AA/AB/AC/AD, Part 20, Sch. 2 GPDO'

issues.detail: Listed building consent has only 'Schedule of works'. Section 4 also requires: Heritage Statement and Design and Access Statement (all LBC); internal sections at 1:20 or 1:10 (removal of internal walls or changes to floors, ceilings or stairs); joinery and architectural feature details (changes to joinery or decorative features); existing and proposed ceiling plans (decorative ceilings or cornices); materials, fixings and finishes specification (all LBC); labelled site photographs with a photo location plan (all LBC); a drawing and document list (all LBC); a structural report and calculations (substantial demolition, excavation or structural alteration); roof plans at 1:50 (roof alterations).

'Structural Survey' ('a full structural report and calculations will be required') and 'Photographs / Photomontages' are placed under Full planning. In the source, the structural report and the site photographs are Listed Building Consent requirements (Section 4). The photographs excerpt ('such as photographs, historic maps, phasing, schedule of works and HER information') is guidance on Heritage Statement content, not a separate requirement.
issues.evidence: Section 4: Structural report and calculations - 'substantial demolition or excavation, or significant structural alteration'; Site photographs - 'All LBC applications'

issues.detail: 'Fire Statement' is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', and its trigger excerpt is the exemption clause ('Fire Statements are not required where: the application is for a material change of use...'). The Fire Statement is a national requirement for relevant buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation. It is not a prior approval requirement, and the excerpt states the opposite of the trigger.
issues.evidence: Section 1 Fire Statement: relevant buildings 18m+/7+ storeys; 'Fire Statements are not required where:' lists material change of use, outline and s73 exemptions

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut-off fragments or text taken from other rows, and do not state when the requirement applies. Affordable Housing Statement: 'values, costs, affordable housing details and assumptions.' is viability text; the real trigger is any residential development, including conversions or changes of use, creating 1+ net additional dwellings. Air Quality: 'mitigation and/or air quality assessment.'; the real trigger is all major developments. BNG: a header fragment ending '...all plans must include'. Block plan: 'and proposed block plans are required.'. Ground investigation: 'application is, a Ground Investigation Report (GIR) is required.' omits the contaminated-land-zone trigger. Environmental Statement: mixes in 'Site Allocations' and 'The BNG condition must be discharged before commencement.'. Viability Assessment: a garbled merge of the affordable housing table ('15+ net dwellings: 40% affordable submitted under the Viability Statement housing...'); the real trigger is any application where s106 obligations will not be met in full. Open space / play space: the excerpt is planning obligations/viability boilerplate. Roof plan: begins with the page footer 'September 2026'. Ecological Survey: the excerpt is about surveyor CIEEM membership, not the trigger. Drainage and Self-build: excerpts start with lists of policy and guidance links.
issues.evidence: e.g. Viability Statement trigger 'Any application where s106 planning obligations will not be met in full'; Air Quality trigger 'All Major Developments'

issues.detail: 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' uses the excerpt 'a full Land Stability Assessment is submitted.' That is the exemption from the Land Stability Declaration Form. Hastings has no coal-mining requirement. Its requirements are a Land Stability/Ground Condition Assessment (unstable land, cliffs, toe or head of slopes, retaining structures) and a Land Stability Declaration Form for all applications in the Article 4 Direction Cliff Stability Area, including upward extensions.
issues.evidence: Land Stability Declaration Form: 'All applications where sites are located in an Article 4 Direction Cliff Stability Area'; not needed if a full Land Stability Assessment is submitted

issues.detail: The BNG row omits the trigger and the exemptions: major applications and small sites subject to the general BNG condition; householder, de minimis and sites of 0.2ha or below (for applications on or after 6 August 2026) are exempt; the self/custom build exemption no longer applies. Section 5's validation items (pre-development metric, degradation statement, irreplaceable habitat, habitat plan) are not captured. Discharge of conditions is marked '(none)', but a Biodiversity Gain Plan is needed to discharge the BNG pre-commencement condition.
issues.evidence: Section 2 BNG row and Section 5 'Biodiversity Net Gain Information'; 'Biodiversity Gain Plan / BNG Management and Monitoring Plan' for discharge of the condition

issues.detail: Heritage Statement excerpt ('They will all require: 1) A Heritage statement AND 2) A Historic Environment Record (HER) checklist...') leaves out the trigger: applications affecting designated or non-designated heritage assets or their setting, and all major development.
issues.evidence: 'Required on all applications which affect designated and nondesignated heritage assets or their setting'

issues.detail: The same Ground Investigation Report requirement appears twice, as 'Contaminated Land / Land Contamination Assessment' (the 250m excerpt) and 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment'. Neither states the main trigger: any site in the contaminated land zone, however minor.
issues.evidence: GIR row: required on sites in the contaminated land zone regardless of how minor the application is; may be required within 250m of contaminated land or landfill

issues.detail: The council tab's 6 tab_items are all drawing-standard text (paper size, A3 printing, scale bars, location plan edging) rather than local requirements, and two pairs are near-duplicates: the location plan text appears twice (once prefixed 'Further Information'), and so does the 'paper size and scale...' text. The tab has 6 items while the reference row claims 24 'Req. items'.
issues.evidence: Section 4 preamble: 'All plans must show north, a scale bar, paper size and scale...'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Hastings Validation Checklist (Version 26, September 2026). The extraction is weak: about 15 Section 2 local requirements, the prior-approval upward-extension section and most LBC items are missing; Householder wrongly shows no local requirements; most trigger excerpts are fragments or text from other rows.
